title: Model
description: Hybrid model: a coarse finite-element solve plus a neural correction, trained end to end. -(k(x) u')' = 1 on (0, 1), u(0) = u(1) = 0, with k(x) = 1 + 0.8 sin(2 pi f x + phase). The input is (f, phase). A 6-cell FEM mesh cannot resolve k; a small dilated conv net sees the coarse solution, k and x on a fine grid and learns the error.
